description: ADTS at 22050 Hz of twelve channel pairs followed by SBR data, the SBR header only in the sixth, as in a stream cut before its first header: the five payloads before it cannot be read, but decoders take the stream for HE-AAC from the first, so it is HE-AAC at 44100 Hz.
findings: 12 of 12 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC
5 raw data blocks hold SBR data before the first SBR header

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
